description: Merge a Git source branch, including its still uncommitted changes, into a target branch through a regular merge, a rebase with fast-forward, or a squash merge, resolving merge conflicts semantically, check that the source branch landed, and emit a MERGED, CONFLICT, or FAILED verdict. Use when the user calls to "merge", "integrate", or "land" a branch.
